subject.title: Gateway runtime: "no such table: plugin_state_entries / acp_sessions" despite tables existing in state/openclaw.sqlite (agent turns produce no reply)

question: Should maintainers require live Docker path diagnostics before allowing a fix PR, or let ClawSweeper start a source-guided diagnostic branch?
rationale: The source paths are clear and the beta update confirms the issue is still relevant, but the central contradiction depends on which SQLite file the failing runtime process is actually querying.

options.title: Require live path diagnostics
options.body: Ask for redacted OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR, resolved shared DB path, and PRAGMA database_list from the failing Docker gateway before choosing the fix boundary.

options.title: Start diagnostic repair branch
options.body: Allow a focused branch to add path diagnostics and regression coverage around shared state DB selection, stopping if the mismatch cannot be reproduced.

recommendation.title: Require live path diagnostics
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR, resolved shared DB path, and PRAGMA database_list from the failing Docker gateway before choosing the fix boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history signal is around the shared SQLite and ACP persistence surfaces.
